reference: glibc iconv (Debian), run by system Bash on the reference side; stdout, status and stderr compared byte for byte.
coverage: Docker parity suite errors/iconv: the usage-error Try line.
exclusions: Only diagnostics are covered here; the reviewed suite in suites/ covers ordinary operation.

cases.purpose: Docker parity errors/iconv: glibc iconv ends each usage error, including a missing option argument, with its "Try `iconv --help' or `iconv --usage'" line, not a usage synopsis.
cases.script:
iconv --bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
iconv -@ </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
iconv -f </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
iconv --from-code </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
iconv -f NOSUCH -t UTF-8 </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
iconv -f UTF-8 -t NOSUCH </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
